Summary
: The Grihya-sutra ascribed to Shankhayana, which has been edited and translated into German in the XVth volume of the "Indische Studien", is based on the first of the four Vedas, the Rig-veda in the Bashkala recension, and among the Brahmana texts, on the Kaushitaka.
Alternative titles: Śāṅkhāyana-gṛhya-sūtra (शाङ्खायन-गृह्य-सूत्र), Shankhayana, Grhya, Śāṅkhāyanagṛhyasūtra (शाङ्खायनगृह्यसूत्र), Sankhayanagrihyasutra, Shankhayanagrihyasutra, Sankhayanagrhyasutra.
